title: Hidden Information, Player Visibility, Discovery & Reveal Projection
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Hidden Information, Player Visibility, Discovery and Reveal Projection over the MAS-01..14 foundations while preserving canonical Knowledge/KFR, Visibility, Investigation/discovery/reveal and Action/Event/runtime owner authority and keeping prepared projections distinct from live player knowledge, visibility, discovery or reveal state.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared hidden-information, player-visibility, discovery and reveal projections inside the MAS workspace without turning prepared projections into canonical visibility, knowledge, discovery, reveal or live runtime truth.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically prepare hidden-information, player-visibility, discovery and reveal projections over completed MAS foundations with explicit canonical owner references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving owner/runtime authority and never treating prepared projections as proof that a player sees, knows, discovered or was revealed anything.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-14 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

Knowledge/KFR retained canonical knowledge/familiarity authority; A9 visibility projection retained authorization-before-projection semantics and player-facing hidden-cardinality protection; D24 Investigation/clue-discovery-reveal retained clue lifecycle, discovery-state mutation and discovery-event authority; Action/Event/runtime owners retained live occurrence, mutation and event authority.

Prepared Hidden Information, Player Visibility, Discovery and Reveal projections never proved player-visible content, player or character knowledge, clue discovery, reveal occurrence or Action/Event truth and exposed no hidden cardinality to unauthorized players.
MAS-15 consumed explicit MAS-14 prepared references plus validated Knowledge, Visibility and InvestigationClue owner bindings; unresolved references fail closed.
Production code remained frozen after minimum GREEN e5f49a2a3d3e3b978b2642f4832fe3cfe346bf06; the proof layer added governance/compliance/verifier surfaces only.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-15.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-15, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-16 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-17+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-15 is closed. MAS-16 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
